parameters.name: children_count
parameters.description: Number of children in the finite set $I$

parameters.name: selection_costs
parameters.description: Selection cost of each child in the ordered set $I$

parameters.name: mandatory_children
parameters.description: Set of mandatory children that must be selected

variables.name: selection_vector
variables.description: Binary decision variable indicating whether each child is selected

constraints.name: binary_selection_vector
constraints.description: Selection variables are binary for each child

constraints.name: minimum_selected_children
constraints.description: The selected group must contain at least the minimum number of children

constraints.name: maximum_selected_children
constraints.description: The selected group must not exceed the capacity limit

constraints.name: mandatory_children_selected
constraints.description: Every mandatory child must be selected

constraints.name: forbidden_pair_exclusion
constraints.description: For each ordered incompatibility pair, selecting the first child forbids selecting the second child

constraints.name: prerequisite_pair_inclusion
constraints.description: For each ordered prerequisite pair, selecting the first child requires selecting the second child

objectives.name: minimize_total_selection_cost
objectives.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen children

final_objective.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen children.
